units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 9:3">Targ. Gen. IX, 3</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 12:9">Targ. Ex. XII, 9</cite> <he>כד חי</he> (half-)raw; a. fr.—
Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII, 7 [read:] חשיך חי דבעי למיתא luckless in the living one that is dependent on the dead; Yalk. ib. 686; a. fr.—Pl. חַיִּין, חַיַּיָּא, חַיֵּי.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 38:20">Targ. Ps. XXXVIII, 20</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 17:13">Targ. Num. XVII, 13</cite>; a. fr.—
Snh. 98ᵇ אי מן ח׳ הוא if he is one of the living (the present age); Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ top; a. fr.—Fem. חַיָּיא, חַיָּא, חַיְּתָא, חַיְּי׳.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 37:2">Targ. Y. ib. XXXVII, 2</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 18b:4">Sabb. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>קדרא ח׳</he> a raw dish.—Pl. <cite ref="H00750"><he>חַיָּיתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00737"><he>חַיָּין</he></cite>.
